posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina's heartwarming May photo dump featured baby Vihaan's tiny hands and cozy family moments from Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday celebration, giving fans a rare window into their private life.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali releases June 12, clashing with Kangana's film. He recently surprised Toronto fans with the trailer during his AURA Tour and sold out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia has kicked off promotions for Alpha, the first female-led film in YRF's Spy Universe, releasing July 3. She also stars in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War with Ranbir Kapoor, set for Christmas 2026.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is deep into filming SS Rajamouli's mega-budget Varanasi with Mahesh Babu, with six months of shoot still pending. She's confirmed for Krrish 4 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Mira Nair's Amri.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action-thriller King with daughter Suhana Khan is confirmed for Christmas 2026, made on a massive ₹350-400 crore budget. Climax scene photos leaked recently, sending fans into a frenzy.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is gearing up for her 2026 big-screen return after skipping 2025 entirely. She's among the Bollywood A-listers mounting ambitious comeback projects this year.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is recovering from a muscle tear sustained on the sets of her upcoming film Eetha. She joked she was 'moving like a Terminator' and reassured fans she'll be fine with rest.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika returns to the big screen in King alongside SRK this Christmas. She's also signed on for Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit opposite Prabhas after initially declining due to her pregnancy.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: After Dhurandhar's record-breaking ₹3,100+ crore franchise, Ranveer is gearing up for Pralay — a ₹300 crore post-apocalyptic zombie thriller directed by Jai Mehta, shooting from August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 with daughter Aaradhya, wearing Amit Aggarwal's sculptural 'Luminara' couture and a dreamy blush pink Sophie Couture gown at the L'Oréal gala.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Newlywed Rashmika is reuniting with Allu Arjun in director Atlee's ambitious sci-fi film AA22xA6, playing one of her most daring roles yet. She's already done her look test and body scan in LA.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's action drama Maa Inti Bangaaram releases June 19 — her big-screen comeback produced under her own Tralala banner. She revealed the role was initially written for Sai Pallavi.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is filming Atlee's massive sci-fi epic AA22xA6 with Deepika Padukone, Janhvi Kapoor, and Rashmika Mandanna. He amicably parted ways with Trivikram's mythological project due to scheduling conflicts.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports-action drama Peddi is a box office storm — crossing ₹150 crore worldwide in just 2 days, with AR Rahman's music earning massive praise.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR is set to reunite with director Trivikram for a Kartikeya/Subrahmanya mythological epic after the project moved from Allu Arjun. War 2 with Hrithik Roshan releases August 14.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars alongside Ram Charan in the blockbuster Peddi, which smashed ₹100 crore worldwide on Day 1. She's also part of Allu Arjun's mega-cast sci-fi AA22xA6 with Atlee.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya is serving major vacation style this summer, featured among Bollywood's beach fashion goals alongside Alia and Janhvi. She continues to turn heads with her effortless off-duty looks.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars in War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR, one of the most anticipated releases of August 2026. The film's epic dance-off sequence between Hrithik and NTR has fans buzzing.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's Krrish 4 directorial debut is stuck over a VFX disagreement with YRF — he wants a top Hollywood studio while Aditya Chopra prefers in-house YFX. Priyanka Chopra confirmed as the female lead.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released June 5 — a classic David Dhawan comedy entertainer with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde. It's positioned as the first major post-IPL Bollywood release.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released the deeply personal 'Siddha Bhajo' — her father's favorite song — on June 1. Her Unstoppable Tour kicks off in Auckland June 20, then Australia and a massive US arena tour in September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is having a prolific 2026 — his music for Ram Charan's Peddi and Diljit Dosanjh's Main Vaapas Aaunga (with Imtiaz Ali) is earning massive praise. Ishq Mastana released June 2.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's final film Jananayagan is targeting a post-June release after Tamil Nadu elections concluded. The ₹500 crore+ magnum opus directed by H. Vinoth marks his grand farewell to cinema.
